description:
Goal
Make compiler2 native lowering and codegen consume the settled shared runtime transport model so direct-only callables stay direct across input, call, return, and resume boundaries without allocating or publishing first-class closures.

Problem being fixed
The direct-callable capture transport bug from fz-hwn.10 is fixed. Native now needs to finish consuming the settled transport model without re-deriving callable or continuation obligations from syntax, types, or legacy return ABI assumptions. The remaining work is native-specific: continuation entry signatures, tuple-field delivery, callable-boundary publication only at true first-class materialization sites, and any other native-only fallback that still widens internal transport.

Current blocker
fz-hwn.11 tracks the next concrete native seam: tuple-field continuations are over-publishing one entry param beyond the delivered field lanes plus real captures.

Scope
- Consume settled runtime input, return, resume, and capture layouts in src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs end to end.
- Keep native local values structural so direct-only callables remain direct until a true first-class boundary demands materialization.
- Keep internal returns/resumes lane-shaped from return_layout instead of relying on ReturnAbi as the internal transport model.
- Publish callable boundaries only when native actually materializes a first-class callable object.
- Keep callable-entry ABI separate from executable-internal transport ABI.

Code seams
- src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs
- src/compiler2/native_codegen/*
- any nearby artifact/native cleanup needed after native stops widening transport locally

Removal target
- Delete any remaining native helper that recovers callable or continuation transport obligations from lambda/function-ref syntax, callable-looking types, or ReturnAbi-only reasoning when settled transport facts already exist.
- Delete temporary native-only fallback paths that materialize closures or whole values solely to satisfy internal transport.

Checks
- Native JIT/AOT tests pass for direct lambda call, escaped lambda, opaque callable, enum reducer cases, quicksort, and direct closure-target fixtures.
- No native path emits MakeClosure/MakeFnRef for direct-only demand.
- No native path publishes callable boundaries from undemanded lambda/function-ref steps.
- Native lowering consumes the settled shared transport model without reintroducing local widening or flat-capture reconstruction.

comments.text: Current seam after mirroring demand-shaped local values into native executable inputs and entry captures: native direct-only callable transport still collapses at DeliveredResume because ReturnAbi can only express Value or TupleFields. Repro: compiler2_native_program_jit_runs_enum_reduce_through_compiler2_codegen fails in LowerNativeProgram with 'native call arg 7 for callee 66 expected direct-callable 65 with 0 capture(s), observed Some(Runtime(Var(7)))'. This indicates a direct-only callable returning through a continuation resume boundary and being rebound as a runtime value. Next correct step is to generalize internal return/resume transport from ReturnAbi::{Value,TupleFields} to the same value-layout model used for runtime params/captures, then thread that through artifact planning, backend interpreter DeliveredResume binding, native entry signatures, delivered_args_for_abi, and NativeDemandAbi/codegen delivered-shape handling. Do not restore old closure materialization to satisfy the test.

title: Compiler2 native: lower direct callable demand without first-class closure materialization
